mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the name under which sociologists study inequality in society, that is, the unequal distribution of goods and services, rights and obligations, power and prestige. (Littlejohn, 1972:9)."

Social structure or social stratification is the name under which sociologists study inequality in society, that is, the unequal distribution of goods and services, rights and obligations, power and prestige. (Littlejohn, 1972:9).

The economy is the focal point of human existence and therefore the media practitioners should understand the economic variables of their society.

Social effects can be defined as direct or indirect influence of a social force on a person or a thing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of transmitting information, ideas, attitudes, values, beliefs through a communication device to a relatively large, heterogeneous and anonymous audience simultaneously."

Mass communication is the process of transmitting information, ideas, attitudes, values, beliefs through a communication device to a relatively large, heterogeneous and anonymous audience simultaneously.

The mass media refers to communicating with large number of people without direct contact.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the modifications of the body of knowledge of people and their tools."
Cultural change is the modifications of the body of knowledge of people and their tools.
